Class ConsumerBlueprint

java.lang.Object
io.fluxzero.sdk.registry.ConsumerBlueprint
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ConsumerBlueprint extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Lifecycle-bound projection of the effective handlers assigned to one consumer. The same contract can later be supplied by generated metadata; it contains no application objects or executable code on the wire.

    • ConsumerBlueprint

      public ConsumerBlueprint(Serializer serializer, Supplier<ConsumerFilter> handlers, LongSupplier revisions, UnaryOperator<ConsumerFilter> inputProjection)
      Projects the serializer's required inputs through an upstream serialized-message transformation, such as a batch interceptor chain. A null projection result means unknown selection and retains broad delivery.

    • mayHandle

      public boolean mayHandle(SerializedMessage message)
      Whether the current conservative projection admits this serialized input, without executing application code.

    • refresh

      public void refresh()
      Publishes a new projection after registration changes; listeners establish the remote activation boundary. Every listener is notified even when another fails. Activation failures remain visible to the caller.

    • observe

      public Registration observe(Consumer<ConsumerFilter> listener)
      Observes future projections. Newly opened reads always carry getFilter() themselves.
